CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified contents present.

COD.rationale: Content (colored cell set), its organization/origin metadata, and a separate status field are all explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No statement links attention/allocation or processing condition to the identified contents' presentation or access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit identifications of content sets with color attributes (red/blue) are present.

D.rationale: The report separately records content identity (cell sets) and metadata/status (origin, record_status) for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: Origins, inheritance and candidate/current labels explicitly describe how contents are organized/presented across record types and times.
